tooltip.overgearedmod.capsule_license.ad: Crafting table: with a basic capsule, 4 diamonds and 2 gold blocks.
tooltip.overgearedmod.capsule_license.di: Crafting table: with an advanced capsule, a netherite block and a nether star.
message.overgearedmod.capsule.starter_fr: You were given a basic capsule to get started.
message.overgearedmod.capsule.starter: You took out a loan of %s Won to buy this capsule. You will pay it off with your work in the real world.
message.overgearedmod.capsule.character_: Your stored character from the other world cannot be read: not crossing so you do not lose your items.
message.overgearedmod.capsule.too_tired: Too tired to connect: energy %s %%, minimum %s %%. Rest in the real world.
message.overgearedmod.capsule.disconnect: Disconnected for safety: your connection time ran out
message.overgearedmod.fatigue_display.au: Energy: shown only while not full
hud.overgearedmod.fatigue_grace.title: Safety protocol
hud.overgearedmod.fatigue_grace.safe: Nothing can hurt you until you disconnect
screen.overgearedmod.fatigue.tooltip: With this energy you last: resting ~%s min, playing ~%s min, fighting ~%s min. It refills in the real world (%s min from empty to full) and by sleeping. The capsule needs at least %s %%.
message.overgearedmod.capsule.nowhere: The capsule cannot find where to connect you (this world has no Satisfy ready)
message.overgearedmod.capsule.only_overw: The capsule only connects from the overworld
message.overgearedmod.capsule.no_satisfy: This world has no Satisfy (only new worlds have it)
message.overgearedmod.capsule.crossing_b: You cannot travel between the real world and Satisfy that way: use the capsule
message.overgearedmod.capsule.bed_ignore: Beds in Satisfy do not set your respawn
message.overgearedmod.capsule.logout_in_: You cannot disconnect while in danger
item.overgearedmod.apprentice_contract.d: Use it on the ground next to a smithing anvil. He takes materials from the chests touching the anvil and leaves what he forges in a barrel touching it, or in the containers you assign him. Right-click: empty-handed, his window; with Satisfy emeralds, his wage (%s a day); with an item, his order.
message.overgearedmod.apprentice_paid_en: %s's wage is already paid well ahead.
message.overgearedmod.apprentice_no_emer: You need %s Satisfy emeralds for a day of wage.
message.overgearedmod.apprentice_assign_: Right-click the container %s will take materials from (at most %s blocks from the anvil).
Right-click the container %s will leave his work in (at most %s blocks from the anvil).
That container is too far from %s's anvil (%s blocks at most).
%s goes back to the containers touching the anvil.
screen.overgearedmod.apprentice.subtitle: %s · %s · smithing %s
message.overgearedmod.apprentice_stage_t: %s hasn't mastered that material yet: he must be %s.
notification.overgearedmod.apprentice.na: %s has a gold name: he is a named NPC and will grow without limit.
notification.overgearedmod.apprentice.cr: %s forged a masterpiece and has been recognised as a Craftsman.
notification.overgearedmod.apprentice.il: Watching you forge a Legendary piece, %s reached illumination: he is a Craftsman now.
screen.overgearedmod.apprentice.pay_tool: Costs %s Satisfy emeralds. You can pay up to %s days ahead.
screen.overgearedmod.apprentice.dismiss_: He will stop working for you and leave. The contract is not given back.
screen.overgearedmod.apprentice.hint: To give him an order, right-click him with the item in hand. With Satisfy emeralds in hand you pay several days at once (%s a day). Sneak while looking at him to observe him: the more Insight, the more you see.
message.overgearedmod.apprentice_max: You already have %s apprentices, the most allowed.
message.overgearedmod.apprentice_needs_l: You need smithing %s for another apprentice.
message.overgearedmod.apprentice_hired: %s is your apprentice. Put him by a smithing anvil with a chest and a barrel touching it, and give him an order. Right-click him empty-handed for his window.
message.overgearedmod.smith_apprentice: Smith: "There's a lad in the village with good hands. Teach him what you know... and pay him every day. Here's his contract."
item.overgearedmod.eye_of_pallalian.desc: A very expensive appraisal item. Use it with an unappraised item in your inventory to reveal what it is.
item.overgearedmod.pagma_rare_book.effec: Whoever reads it becomes Pagma's Successor, the legendary blacksmith.
item.overgearedmod.pagma_rare_book.warni: Using it changes your level and stats.
screen.overgearedmod.read_pagma_book.mes: You will become Pagma's Successor. You go back to level 1, lose your stat points and your class skills, and get 20 extra points. This can't be undone. Read it?
item.overgearedmod.unappraised.tooltip: Needs appraisal to reveal its effects.
item.overgearedmod.fracaso_blueprint.des: Only Pagma's Successor can use it: at the anvil, with 15 blue orichalcum ingots. Used up by the forge.
stat.overgearedmod.strength.desc: Per point: +%s attack damage. Boosts area skill damage.
stat.overgearedmod.intelligence.desc: Per point: +%s max mana and +%s mana per second.
stat.overgearedmod.dexterity.desc: Per point: +%s%% attack speed. Improves forging ratings and enhancement odds.
item.overgearedmod.smithing_hammer.desc: In either hand, it improves the rating of what you forge (with two, the better one counts). You can also give it to an apprentice from his window. Each piece wears it a little.
screen.overgearedmod.apprentice.hammer_t: Give: hand him your best smithing hammer. Take: he gives it back.
screen.overgearedmod.workshop.empty: No apprentices yet. At smithing %s, talk to Smith in Bairan: he will give you the first contract.
message.overgearedmod.workshop_far: %s is too far away to open his window.
screen.overgearedmod.workshop.tip.stale: Out of reach: this is not live news
item.overgearedmod.workshop_ledger.desc: Use it to see your apprentices: what they do, their orders and their wage.
screen.overgearedmod.npc_no_quests: I have nothing for you right now.
rumor.overgearedmod.north_cave: My father used to say a legendary blacksmith spent his last years in a cave in the far north. Nobody has managed to find it.
rumor.overgearedmod.singing_anvil: Some days the anvil sings. A perfect strike draws more from the metal than it promised.
rumor.overgearedmod.an_apprentice: A true smith does not work alone. Once your hammer is worth enough, someone will want to learn from you.
rumor.overgearedmod.white_metal: The old miners speak of a white metal, light as a feather, hidden in the stone.
rumor.overgearedmod.night_calls: The guards say whoever hunts enough skeletons ends up hearing something in the night nobody else hears.
rumor.overgearedmod.the_earl: Earl Ashur does not receive just anyone, but they say he pays well to those who have proven themselves at the forge.
rumor.overgearedmod.old_smith_of_winston: I have an old friend in Winston, Khan. He was the best blacksmith in the region until the Mero Company took his customers. Someone with Pagma's legacy might give him back the will to forge.
rumor.overgearedmod.winston_drunk: In Winston they say old Khan doesn't forge any more: he spends the day drinking in his ruined smithy and throws out anyone who walks in.
rumor.overgearedmod.hidden_talents: There is more talent in Bairan than meets the eye. It takes a good eye to see who is worth it.
rumor.overgearedmod.moonlit_ore: My smiths would give a year of wages for blue orichalcum. They say it is born of moonlight, deep beneath the forests.
rumor.overgearedmod.old_relics: An unappraised old item is a mystery. Bring it to me as it is: appraising it would only bring you trouble.
rumor.overgearedmod.unchosen_paths: Some paths nobody chooses. They are earned... or they find you.
rumor.overgearedmod.breathing_bellows: A good bellows does not blow: it breathes. Whoever finds its rhythm takes more metal out of the smelter than they put in.
rumor.overgearedmod.moon_hunters: The guards who hunt under the moon come back changed. They say the night rewards those who do not fear it.
rumor.overgearedmod.watchful_eyes: A noble looks before speaking. Whoever learns to observe people ends up seeing what nobody tells them.
screen.overgearedmod.no_quests_story: No quests to do right now.
screen.overgearedmod.quest_track_tooltip: Show this quest on the HUD panel (up to %s).
screen.overgearedmod.confirm_class_chang: Claiming this quest will change your class from %s to %s. This can't be undone. Continue?
screen.overgearedmod.confirm_class_first: Claiming this quest will give you the class %s. This can't be undone. Continue?
screen.overgearedmod.no_titles: You have no titles yet. They are earned without warning.
screen.overgearedmod.no_skills: You don't know any skill yet. Read a skill book.
screen.overgearedmod.forge_auto.tooltip: Automatic forging: takes a few seconds depending on your smithing and DEX. Normal odds.
screen.overgearedmod.forge_auto.contest: In the contest only manual forging counts.
screen.overgearedmod.forge_manual.toolti: Manual forging: heat the metal and hammer it. Done well, a better rating and maybe an extra option; done badly, worse than automatic. Double smithing XP.
screen.overgearedmod.batch.tooltip: Batch forging: Auto forges this many in a row, each with its own rating. Click to change the amount.
screen.overgearedmod.batch.locked: Batch forging: unlocked at smithing level 10.
screen.overgearedmod.smelter_auto.toolti: Lights the fire and melts one piece after another once it is hot enough. May give an extra ingot by your smithing level. Heating up from cold burns fuel twice as fast.
screen.overgearedmod.smelter_fire.toolti: Douses the fire at once: the burning piece of fuel is lost and the smelter starts to cool.
screen.overgearedmod.smelter_bellows.too: Melts one piece by hand with the bellows. If it is cold, it lights the fire first and tells you when it is ready. Done well: faster, maybe an extra ingot and double smithing XP; overheat it or let it cool and some metal ends up as slag.
minigame.overgearedmod.title: Manual forging
minigame.overgearedmod.heat: Hold (click or space) to heat and release when the temperature is in the golden band
minigame.overgearedmod.hammer: Strike (click or space) when the marker crosses the middle · %s/%s
minigame.overgearedmod.smelt_pump: Click or press space to pump the bellows and keep the metal in the golden zone.
class.overgearedmod.warrior.desc: Melee fighter. Starts with Pagma's Swordsmanship: Link.
class.overgearedmod.blacksmith.desc: Forges better gear and takes hits. Starts with Iron Guard.
class.overgearedmod.mage.desc: More mana and ranged spells. Starts with Flame Bolt.
class.overgearedmod.legendary_smith_succ: Advanced class. Great dexterity and far better smithing. Obtained through the quest Pagma's Legacy.
class.overgearedmod.night_hunter.desc: Hidden class. Agile and deadly against what lurks in the dark. Starts with Rending Slash.
title.overgearedmod.apprentice_smith.des: You have forged 5 items at the anvil.
title.overgearedmod.epic_forger.desc: You have forged an item of Epic rating or better.
quest.overgearedmod.zombie_plague.desc: Zombies prowl around the village. Repeatable.
quest.overgearedmod.first_commission.des: Smith trusts you with your first real commission: forge any item at the anvil.
quest.overgearedmod.quality_test.desc: Smith wants to see whether your first commission was luck. Forge two Rare or better items, automatically or by hand: both count.
quest.overgearedmod.call_of_the_night.de: So many broken bones have not gone unnoticed. Something in the dark is watching you: hunt 15 more skeletons and answer its call. Replaces your current class.
quest.overgearedmod.night_watch.desc: You held the zombies back. Now the chief asks you to deal with the skeletons that prowl the village at night.
quest.overgearedmod.watch_commander.desc: Bairan has nobody to lead its watch. Clear the surroundings of zombies and the chief will hand you the Commander's Sword: they say whoever wields it learns to read people.
quest.overgearedmod.bairan_talents.desc: The chief lends you the Ruler's Sword, carried only by a recognised lord, to look for hidden talents among Bairan's residents. Use it (right-click) near them. You give it back when you finish.
item.overgearedmod.commanders_sword.desc: The sword of whoever leads the soldiers. It helps to notice people.
item.overgearedmod.rulers_sword.desc: Only given to a recognised lord. Used to watch soldiers and residents closely.
item.overgearedmod.insight_sword.observa: Character Observation: observe %s %% faster and see as with +%s Insight
item.overgearedmod.insight_sword.talent_: Talent Search (right-click): reveals hidden talents and named NPCs nearby; each new talent found raises Insight by 2
item.overgearedmod.loaned: Lent for "%s": given back when it ends
message.overgearedmod.quest_loaned: You have been lent what you need for "%s".
message.overgearedmod.quest_loan_returne: You give back what was lent to you for "%s".
quest.overgearedmod.path_of_the_adventur: Prove your progress and receive a skill book.
quest.overgearedmod.smith_firewood.desc: Smith doesn't teach the trade to just anyone. Prove you can work: bring him 64 logs for the forge.
quest.overgearedmod.smith_iron.desc: The forge is lit, but there is no metal. Dig in the mountain mine and bring Smith 32 raw iron (or the ores).
quest.overgearedmod.smith_jaffa_ingots.d: Smith teaches you to smelt jaffa. Mine jaffa ore, smelt it and hand him 8 ingots.
quest.overgearedmod.smith_jaffa_sword.de: Time to forge: with two jaffa ingots and a stick, forge a Jaffa sword at the anvil.
quest.overgearedmod.pagma_legacy.desc: Read Pagma's Rare Book to become Pagma's Successor. No conditions.
quest.overgearedmod.giver.earl_ashur: Talk to Earl Ashur at his manor
quest.overgearedmod.giver.khan: Talk to Khan at his smithy in Winston
quest.overgearedmod.ashur_secret_request: Find Pagma's Rare Book in the Northern End Cave, far to the north of Bairan (the earl's map marks it), and bring it to him unopened. Nobody must know.
quest.overgearedmod.ashur_anger.desc: You appraised the book the earl wanted for himself. Ashur, a level 300 great magician, and his knights are hunting you. To be free of them, kill Earl Ashur.
title.overgearedmod.became_legend.desc: You read Pagma's Rare Book. You sometimes resist harmful effects and, once every 5 minutes, a killing blow leaves you at 1 health.
title.overgearedmod.noble_killer.desc: You killed Earl Ashur. Nobles despise you; some commoners admire you.
title.overgearedmod.night_stalker.desc: You have slain 50 monsters at night.
title.overgearedmod.tireless_forger.desc: You have forged 50 items at the anvil.
title.overgearedmod.anvil_blessed.desc: The anvil has granted you three great successes.
title.overgearedmod.bellows_master.desc: You have won 10 extra ingots with the smelter's bellows.
title.overgearedmod.keen_eye.desc: You have gained 20 Insight points by observing.
title.overgearedmod.talent_scout.desc: You have found 3 people with hidden talent.
quest.overgearedmod.moonlit_hunt.desc: The night no longer scares you, and something in it has noticed. Slay 10 zombies at night to prove the dark is your ground.
quest.overgearedmod.perfect_bellows.desc: The metal gave you more than it promised. Keep the same rhythm and win 5 extra ingots with the smelter's bellows.
quest.overgearedmod.smiths_gaze.desc: You have begun to see what others overlook. Observe calmly and gain 10 more Insight points.
quest.overgearedmod.steady_hand.desc: One great success may be luck; three Epic pieces are not. Forge 3 items of Epic rating or better.
goal.overgearedmod.milestone.bellows_ext: Win %s extra ingots with the bellows
goal.overgearedmod.forge_rating: Forge %s items of %s rating or better
skill.overgearedmod.pagma_link.desc: Fan-shaped slash in front of you. Scales with STR and DEX. Needs a sword.
skill.overgearedmod.bisection.desc: A long, straight cut that splits whatever is in front of you. Scales with STR. Only with a Legendary Failure in hand, on the weapon skill key.
skill.overgearedmod.iron_guard.desc: Resistance II and absorption for a few seconds.
skill.overgearedmod.flame_bolt.desc: Throws three small fireballs where you look.
skill.overgearedmod.rending_slash.desc: A short slash that makes enemies bleed (Bleeding II). Requires a sword.
notification.overgearedmod.title: You have earned a title
notification.overgearedmod.item.unapprai: It needs appraisal to reveal its effects.
notification.overgearedmod.quest_discove: You have discovered a hidden quest
message.overgearedmod.wrong_item: %s: can't be used with what you are holding
message.overgearedmod.smelter_manual_los: The melt was lost: the metal or the heat changed
message.overgearedmod.manual_refused: The result didn't count: it came too fast or too late
message.overgearedmod.smelter_no_fuel: There is no fuel to light the fire
message.overgearedmod.smelter_heating: Lit: heating up to %s° for the bellows…
message.overgearedmod.cave_relic: The system won't let you take anything from this place.
message.overgearedmod.ashur_nobody: Earl Ashur: "I have no time for a nobody. Come back when Smith thinks something of you."
message.overgearedmod.ashur_secret: Earl Ashur: "I have heard of you, blacksmith. I have a... discreet request. Take this map."
message.overgearedmod.ashur_thief: Earl Ashur: "Thief! That book is mine."
message.overgearedmod.smith_tells_of_kha: Smith: "So now you carry Pagma's legacy... An old friend of mine, Khan, lives in Winston. He was an excellent blacksmith, but the Mero Company ruined him and now he only drinks. Take this map: maybe you can help him."
message.overgearedmod.khan_drunk.1: Khan: "Another customer? Nothing gets forged here any more. Go away."
message.overgearedmod.khan_drunk.2: Khan: "Leave me alone... *hic*... the Mero Company has taken everything."
message.overgearedmod.khan_drunk.3: Khan: "Out of my smithy. If you want a hammer, buy one from the Mero."
message.overgearedmod.ashur_arrives: Earl Ashur: "I knew someone as ordinary as you would find it... and that greed would open it. Give it to me."
message.overgearedmod.ashur_took_book: Earl Ashur took Pagma's Rare Book.
message.overgearedmod.read_pagma_book: You read Pagma's Rare Book. You are now Pagma's Successor... and back at level 1.
message.overgearedmod.pagma_book_already: You already know everything this book can teach you.
message.overgearedmod.legend_saved: "One Who Became a Legend": you held on against death.
message.overgearedmod.smelter_ready: The smelter is ready for the bellows
message.overgearedmod.smelter_extra: A pure melt! An extra ingot
message.overgearedmod.requirements_unmet: You don't meet this item's requirements
message.overgearedmod.death_xp_lost: You died and lost %s XP from your current level
message.overgearedmod.quest_tracking_ful: You already follow %s quests on the HUD
message.overgearedmod.respec_done: Points refunded: you have %s to spend
message.overgearedmod.respec_nothing: You have no allocated points to refund
message.overgearedmod.simulate_not_a_mob: That entity is not a mob
message.overgearedmod.debug_smithing: Smithing set to level %s (effective, with the class: %s)
message.overgearedmod.debug_goto_none: This world has no %s (only new worlds have one)
message.overgearedmod.debug_goto_sea: %s is in the sea: there is no dry ground there to land on
message.overgearedmod.debug_quest_comple: Quest %s completed (%s quests marked done; rewards only for the requested quest)
message.overgearedmod.debug_apprentice_r: No apprentice: raise smithing first (/satisfy debug set smithing)
screen.overgearedmod.insight.tooltip: Not allocated with points: it grows by observing. Sneak while looking at an NPC or a monster for %s seconds (each one teaches once a day; the more Insight, the quicker). The more Insight, the more Character Observation shows you.
notification.overgearedmod.insight.mediu: You now see your apprentices' level, fail chance and pace.
notification.overgearedmod.insight.high: You now see NPC grades and how far they can grow.
quest.overgearedmod.khans_rage.desc: Help Khan, who fell for the Mero Company's tricks and lost his customers: drive the Mero's thugs out of his smithy and destroy the transfer contract. You have 7 days, or Khan will die.
goal.overgearedmod.milestone.contract_de: Drive off the thugs and tear up the transfer contract
message.overgearedmod.quest_cannot_aband: A quest against the clock can't be abandoned.
notification.overgearedmod.fatigue_warni: You have %s %% of your energy left.
notification.overgearedmod.fatigue_exhau: Safety protocol: the system will disconnect you in a few seconds.
notification.overgearedmod.quest_warning: Less than a day left to complete it.
skill.overgearedmod.blacksmith_rage.desc: The rage of a trampled blacksmith: +10% attack for 30 seconds.
item.overgearedmod.transfer_contract.des: The contract that would hand Khan's smithy to the Mero Company. Right-click to tear it up.
message.overgearedmod.contract_torn: You tear the transfer contract to pieces. Khan's smithy won't belong to the Mero.
message.overgearedmod.mero_thugs_arrive: Mero Company thugs burst into the smithy! "Sign it already, you old drunk..."
message.overgearedmod.khans_rage_done: Khan: "...Thank you. Nobody has stood by me in years. No more drinking: this smithy will ring again."
message.overgearedmod.khan_sober: Khan: "Ah, it's you! Come in, the forge is hot again."
message.overgearedmod.khan_lost: Khan won't speak to you. You failed him when he needed you most.
message.overgearedmod.khan_died: The days went by and nobody stopped the Mero Company... Khan is dead. His quests are lost forever.
message.overgearedmod.khan_died_for_you: The days went by and you didn't stop the Mero Company. For you, Khan is finished: he won't speak to you again and his quests are lost forever.
quest.overgearedmod.khans_contest.desc: The Mero Company has hired Euphemina to take Khan's smithy for good. Beat her in the production contest on Winston's square: one piece forged by hand at the stage, against the clock.
goal.overgearedmod.milestone.contest_won: Beat Euphemina in the contest on the square
title.overgearedmod.khans_disciple.desc: Khan, Winston's old blacksmith, teaches you all he knows.
screen.overgearedmod.khans_contest.messa: You will have %s minutes to forge a single piece by hand at the stage anvil. Khan gives you 2 jaffa ingots and a stick. Euphemina is ready... Shall we begin?
message.overgearedmod.khans_contest_acce: Khan: "The Mero has hired a smith, Euphemina, to take my smithy fair and square. She's waiting on the stage in the square. I'll hold the metal for you."
message.overgearedmod.euphemina_beaten: Euphemina: "...You won fair and square. Next time won't be the same."
message.overgearedmod.contest_go_to_khan: Euphemina: "Go to your master. You got what you wanted."
message.overgearedmod.euphemina_tomorrow: Euphemina: "You've lost today. Come back tomorrow, if you dare."
message.overgearedmod.contest_started: The contest begins! Khan hands you the materials. You have %s minutes: forge one piece by hand at the stage anvil.
message.overgearedmod.contest_by_hand: Only manual forging counts in the contest.
message.overgearedmod.contest_won: The square erupts in cheers. Khan: "I knew it! Come to my smithy, we need to talk."
message.overgearedmod.contest_lost_for_g: The judges give the win to Euphemina. The Mero Company keeps Khan's smithy...
message.overgearedmod.contest_lost_remat: The judges give the win to Euphemina. Khan: "Never mind. We'll try again tomorrow."
message.overgearedmod.khans_contest_done: Khan: "From today you are my disciple. All I know is yours." Khan's smithy stands again.
message.overgearedmod.khan_master: Khan: "My disciple! Come in, the forge is lit."
message.overgearedmod.khan_contest_lost: Khan has gone back to drinking. The smithy belongs to the Mero now, and he wants nothing to do with you.
screen.overgearedmod.trade.empty: You carry no rated equipment to sell.
screen.overgearedmod.trade.confirm_sell: Pieces: %s · You will receive %s Satisfy emeralds.
screen.overgearedmod.trade.tip.saturatio: You sold many pieces like this: the price drops and recovers over the days.
trade.overgearedmod.refusal.stacked: Only sold one at a time
message.overgearedmod.trade_stale: The piece or its price changed. Check the list and try again.
message.overgearedmod.trade_skipped: %s piece(s) were not sold: they or their price changed. Check the list.
message.overgearedmod.trade_failed: The sale could not be completed.
screen.overgearedmod.terminal.title: Account and trade
screen.overgearedmod.terminal.subtitle: Item trading site
message.overgearedmod.terminal.worked: Shift done: +%s Won to your account
message.overgearedmod.terminal.not_enoug: You are missing items for today's order.
message.overgearedmod.terminal.invalid_a: That amount has changed: look again.
message.overgearedmod.phone.given: You got a phone: use it to open your account from the real world.
message.overgearedmod.debug_terminal: Terminal: stored emeralds: %s; today's order: %s; last shift: %s (today: %s)
screen.overgearedmod.terminal.capsules.r: Recovery: %s min from empty to full
screen.overgearedmod.terminal.capsules.n: The license goes to your inventory; the capsule is made at a crafting table.
message.overgearedmod.terminal.no_charac: There is no Satisfy character to put the purchase in.
screen.overgearedmod.terminal.shop.note: What you buy goes to your Satisfy character's stored inventory.
message.overgearedmod.terminal.license.d: Pay off the debt to buy the advanced license.
message.overgearedmod.terminal.license.n: You need an advanced capsule first.
message.overgearedmod.terminal.not_enoug: You do not have enough Won.
message.overgearedmod.terminal.no_room: It does not fit in your character's stored inventory.
message.overgearedmod.terminal.sold_out: You already bought that piece today.
message.overgearedmod.terminal.worked_de: Shift done: +%s Won to your account · %s Won to the debt
message.overgearedmod.terminal.worked_se: Shift done: +%s Won to your account · Debt settled
message.overgearedmod.terminal.debt_paid: You paid %s Won of the debt. %s Won left.
message.overgearedmod.terminal.no_debt: You have no debt to pay.
message.overgearedmod.debt.settled: Grid: "That's it. The capsule is truly mine." Debt settled.
screen.overgearedmod.terminal.work_split: %s to your account · %s to the debt
message.overgearedmod.debug_capsule: Capsule: %s, rested %s, cooldown %s, session %s min, recovery %s min, licenses: %s
